source_commits.scope: Decision 0137 (AMR-03.2.2): RuntimeResearchAdmission binds an exactly encoded schema 2 network plan, the run's budget context and one public GET tool with a single network effect under a single-use grant; the sealed request names it in exactly one 'Research admission digest' constraint; new_with_research_admission composes a durable read-only new run of the admission's own context with the admitted tool once beside ordinary read tools, and every other constructor refuses a request that names an admission; at start the coordinator publishes the plan as a run-level JSON report, flushes the journal and has the RuntimeResearchBudgetPort open the budget for exactly that artifact, continuing only for that plan, the admission's scope and an unspent first revision; only the admitted tool may return a network result (a changed success that is the six-member public GET completion prepared through the borrowed builder under its receipt, an uncertain attempt, or an outcome that changed nothing); a coordinator test module and the coordinator architecture document

review_resolved: none: this batch follows batch 21, whose independent review is still requested

components.scope: component row, engine only: the coordinator's side of an admitted research run as above, tested through the real coordinator with synthetic ports (the positive admitted run with plan publication, journal flush, budget opening and the six prepared completion artifacts; each composition refusal; each budget answer refused; each admitted and refused network result; an unprepared success; a resumed admitted run refused even with its checkpoint; ordinary constructors refusing an admission line). Reservation, grant consumption and dual-proof dispatch stay with the existing owners behind the trusted correctness port and are not composed here (AMR-03.1.2.1); no host, worker, provider, model or grant issuance uses the admission

mutation_checks: run on the exact source tree before it was committed, with private tooling that applies one exact replacement, runs the engine's filtered library tests and restores the file; the specifications and results are attached to the batch22-source stage. First run: 35 single mutations over the admission's plan, context and tool checks and its digest, each composition check, the plan publication, flush and budget checks at start, and the admitted execution rule; 31 made their expected test fail. The 4 survivors were resolved before the commit: a tool declaring a network effect under a read grant gained a test case; the digest preimage was reduced to independent members (the plan digest covers the task, scope and network mode, the definition digest covers the tool's identity and version), so two equivalent mutations no longer exist; and a resumed admitted run is now refused in a test that resumes from the run's own committed checkpoint. A rerun of 7 mutations (the four survivors as applicable and each digest member) caught all 7
